seed_strategy.rule: paired seeds across arms; seed is the inferential unit, not ticks or neurons; confirmatory N requires prospective power/precision review

stopping_rule: Fixed requested tick window (60..10000) for native screens; no outcome-dependent stopping. Abort and retain failures on nonfinite state or safety contract violation.
inclusion_criteria: all requested seeds and arms, including failures
all provenance, timing and parameter records present
exclusion_criteria: invalid configuration or corrupted artifacts; retain in audit log, never silently replace seeds

analysis_plan.estimand: within-seed difference in primary outcome; report all arms and negative results
analysis_plan.uncertainty: exploratory paired effect distribution; no p-value from 3 smoke seeds
analysis_plan.confirmatory: freeze seed count, effect threshold, multiplicity correction (Holm) and holdout before first confirmatory run

interpretation_limit: Needs a licensed, hashed biological subset, exact source parameters and independent reference outcomes; Izhikevich is a variant, not an exact LIF replication.
